These reusable cups work great! I feel good about reducing our contribution to the landfill😉
Great. I fill up at night. place in container and pop them in in the morning. Saves me 30 dollars a week in k cup. Plus, I use my own strength for coffee..
Did not work for my Keurig coffee maker WHAT A WAST OF MONEY. Pumped water all over the place.
Bought for my Keurig to use my own coffee. Works great!
Works great, some spillage if you like your coffee strong

This product is exactly what I wanted...so far I have no complaints about this product....great compliment for my Keurig coffee maker.
delivered promptly, however these filters do leak on the sides.  although they do look like other pods the do not work as well.

These filters result in water sprayed all over and weak, weak coffee. Yes, I know how to use them. I thought I was ordering the exact same item as a friend, but mine are different and of crap quality. In fact, I had two different people try these in their machines after they witnessed how poorly they worked in mine and both reported they did the same thing. We all use reusable filters, but these are worthless and I'll have to buy more reliable ones at a local store. Buying from Amazon is getting to be more hit and miss.
Work great as long as you don't loose the small washer that sits inside the top. Otherwise they leak.
Dissatisfied with all six of them. They leak profusely around the edges.  I ended up throwing them all away.
The cups were not compatible.
A huge disappointment. I used them and ended up leaking. Don't buy.

No instructions...
They work fine!
Great product and great service

They advertise that they fit the Keurig machine and they DO NOT. The water spills out all over as you try and brew a cup of coffee. The pod is too large for the machine and therefore the lid doesn't fit properly creating the spill over.

I've got a dozen of these now. They are much cheaper to use than prefilled pods.  Be careful of one thing, though.  There is a little disc in the lid of each pod that can come out and get lost. I think I lost two of mine when I was tapping out the used coffee grounds into the trash. Didn't realize they were missing until the next time I made coffee and it went everywhere but in the cup.  Love these things but, they don't make replacement parts so, always check to make sure that you don't lose the little disc.

Not sure how many times I've ordered and re-ordered these, but I know this will not be my last time of ordering.  Love these coffee pod filters.  I fill it with my own delicious coffee and even if one breaks, or the elastic comes off, it's so inexpensive that it doesn't really matter.  It comes in sets of 6 so there's plenty.  So blessed to find this on Amazon.  Fits my Keurig perfectly.
Love it.  I find that if I use a medium grind it works best for my taste!!!

I lost some of the little caps on the top before I realized they were separate.  Without the cap, water spills out without going through the coffee.  I have some older filters where the top is all one piece which is much better.  I like refillable pods because it is much less expensive than the prefilled K- cups.  It is also better for the environment not to add the disposable ones to our landfills or recycling.
Work and clean up nicely. Just be sure to snap the lid shut tightly, or some grains might sneak out.
Design prevents needle in machine from bending. No problem with leaking
These are great! Wish everyone would use these so we can stop filling our landfills with K cups.

As someone else mentioned, the little black disc at the top of the filter fall out easily. If you don't have one in there, water spurts out everywhere. Additionally the hinges for the lid aren't very sturdy and one by one mine have been breaking.

They are a nice alternative to buying pods, however I will remain on the lookout for ones that are sturdier that fit my machine. My in-laws have ones that are better, but they don't fit my machine.

Works Great!  I have tried several other types of Pod Filters including very expensive ones and they would just explode spilling the coffee and grounds all over the place.  The clean up was not fun at all and very frustrating.  These Pods don't explode and the lid stays on nice and tight with no  coffee mess and are easy to clean.  I would recommend these to anyone who enjoys their favorite brand of coffee.

I love these little baskets!  Just fill them with a scoop into the coffee canister and brew.  Enjoy your favorite coffee blends and brands without paying K-cup prices.  Easy to clean.  Open, dump, rinse.
Works great
these work well and are fairly sturdy
Easy to clean. Fit great. Priced right.
works perfect!
They work great but the lid doesn't snap closed very tight
Fits my Keurig K75 perfectly after many failed attempts with other brands. Very happy!
These are great! I'm glad I found them here after the retailers quit caring them. I may buy more. Thanks!
Good price
Perfect for what we wanted. Been using these daily for the last few months with multiple dishwasher cleanings per week - held up great so far. Fit our Keurig K55 perfect.
They work very well.
They were the perfect size and work much better than the ones I already had . Plus you don't have anything on the bottom part of the pods so you don't have to fit them in any certain way.

Strainer holes in top are too large, allowing coffee grounds come out of the hole in the lid.  In addition, the hole in the lid is kind of large for the needle, so some water and coffee grounds come out of that too.  Answer someone provided about fitting in a Keurig B145 was different from my experience--the filters I received didn't fit in the B145 at my work.  (If they fit in the B145 coffee maker, I would continue using the Easy-cup 2.0 filters.)
Not bad, they serve there purpose. They may leak from the lid a little, but it is minor in my books. I like the design better then some other brands.
Just what we needs and easy to use
Love them for my Keurig
Once I learned how they went in, I was thrilled with them.  Great by and great price.  Would highly recommend them.
Average quality
PERFECT Item for my Coffee Maker....
Omg!! I love this little washer! Its small but it sure is mighty! LOVE IT!
Came on the first day of the estimated dates and once I plugged it in, I was off and washing. Spin cycle on 1 minute gets my clothes 90% dry with no dripping. Perfect size as well.

I almost did not purchase this wonderful machine, but I AM VERY GLAD I DID. I was considering the Panda at more than double the price. I would give more stars if it were possible. SUPER purchase!!!!
The capacity of this little machine is amazing, It washes very well,and its drying cycle is PERFECT. Clothing come out with NO WRINKLES!!!! YES, not a type-O CLEAN AND NO WRINKLES!!!
Now, to my one negative: the attachment part of the water intake hose does not fit my bathroom sink. The water intake hose is quite flimsy. I went to Lowe's and to Home Depot, but I did not find any possible solution among the myriad of fittings they have.
I resolved to use the handle of my shower to fill the basin for washing and again for rinsing. The drainage hose fits perfectly in my toilet once I lift both parts of the toilet seat; I place the the drainage hose, then, I close the toilet seat, and voila', les jeux son faits!, CAVEAT: DO NOT SIT ON THE TOILET OR THE DRAINAGE HOPE AND ITS ATTACHMENT MAY BREAK!!!!
Great machine. Small and mighty, but I wish the drain system was much better. You need to lift and tilt it to completely get the water out, besides that it's a really good machine.

This portable washer dryer is perfect for my needs as I can no longer go down the stairs into the basement and use the full sized washer and dryer. My only complaint is the manual is useless. The pictures and instructions don't match my unit. This is the newest model and the manual apparently is for the previous model. I wrote to the seller who provided a YouTube link that shows how to operate the unit. An updated manual is in the works.

Controls are pretty simple. There are 3 knobs. The washer knob sets the timer for up to 15 minutes. The center knob is for delicate, normal, and drain functions. The dryer knob is the timer for the spin dryer.

The water intake hose is useless. It won't connect to anything and is too short even if it did. Best to just use a bucket. In my case, my shower wand will reach inside the washer and I use it to fill the tub.

The spin dryer gets clothes reasonably dry. They have to be hung to air dry completely. A heated dryer would need venting which would require significant modifications to the room. Spin drying is an acceptable alternative.

Pros:
It washes and spins very well in a short amount of time.

Cons:
The input hose doesn't fit the faucet, so I had to use a bucket to fill the washer.
The washer will not begin to drain unless the water level is higher the highest point in the drain hose. If the water level is too low you need to prime it like a siphon or add more water to the tub to get it started.
There is a strong unpleasant odor from the plastic.

HUGE tub for washing, very efficient and cheap. Works the best if you run the clothes once with soap and again with just water to rinse. dryer is just a spin dryer, you still need to hang them up to finish drying but it saves your hands! i use this for my daughter and myself for regular use. Can even fit a load of sheets...VERY awesome product. a lot better than running to the laundrymat on a weekly basis.
Just what I  wanted.  Very useful.
Very good washer

It worked for a couple of months, then died. The seller will not pay for the shipping to return it, so I'm just stuck with this piece of junk. I liked how dry the clothes got with the spinner, and was super excited about it when I first got it. The power cord is very short, so I had to buy an extension cord with a ground plug. The pump is not strong enough to pump over the edge of the bathtub. I have to put the whole thing into the bathtub and leave the hose laying on the bottom of the tub to drain. (I contacted the seller and they confirmed this fact). Even using it this way the pump went out within a few weeks. The directions are very hard to understand. The hoses don't fit onto any facet that I have, so I have to either hold the hose, or fill with a bucket. I decided to fill with a bucket.
worked good for 2 months. then crapped out for no reason. small loads, i used reg laundry soap, never over did it.
Not bad. But it will be better if the water inlet hose could be used on various types of water tap.

This item was dead on arrival. I can not say how disappointing it was because I waited all week for it to come in. When nothing worked on it, I was extremely disappointed. Unfortunately the box did not ship well so shipping it back will be a pain. I would stay clear of this product.

I have had this machine for a month now. I have used it at least 2 dozen times. I have moved it to several locations, currently it's in the bathroom. The drainage works best in the tub. If the tubing isn't flat, it is harder to drain all the water out. I use a bucket to fill the drum with water. I live an a older apartment building, I couldn't find any hoses that would fit my shower head. Bucket works fine. I find liquid soap the best to use. Less is best, try a tablespoon full and see how sudsy it gets before adding more. I do wash the clothes 2-3 cycles (each is upto 15 minutes), and rinse 1-2 more. The spin drum works amazingly well. Under clothes are almost dry when removed. It easily hold a dozen under garments, or two standard size bath towels, or a pair of jeans. Similar to any wash machine, if you pack it to full, the clothes won't get clean. For washing there is a choice between soft or normal speed settings. The soft setting is perfect for fine items that I would normally wash by hand. I did purchase a small dryer that I use for the heavier items. The washer is a bit more work then using a standard size machine. It is perfect for doing small loads or using for items you would normally wash by hand. The machine is much more convenient then making multiple trips to our apartment buildings laundry rooms. Items that I normally wash by hand seem cleaner and dry faster since the spin drum works so well. The washer is too small to clean large loads, blankets...

I'm very happy to have this washer/spin dryer. I looked at a lot of similar models before selecting this one, and I'm happy with my choice. I suggest using VERY little detergent (no more than a tablespoon, certainly).
I find it convenient to use two 5-gallon plastic buckets for water drainage, alternating them when they're about half full. When the first bucket is about half full, I turn off the Drain setting. When the water pauses its flow through the hose, I slip the hose into the next bucket and flip the dial back to the Drain setting while emptying the first bucket. It's quite easy to lift half a bucket of water and empty it into the toilet or tub, and I can repeat the procedure with alternating buckets as long as I need to.
There is a lint filter in the washer section, and it's worth checking/cleaning out once a month or so, depending upon your volume of weekly wash.
I'm fortunate to have a balcony running the length of my apartment (upstairs in a two story house), with lacy old wrought iron that graciously serves as a sturdy, unique, and lovely clothesline! The clothes don't remain outside for long, however, as the spin dryer leaves fabric only slightly damp. In fact, if you're interested in doing so, you could probably iron them dry.
In short, I love the convenience of being able to do laundry in my own apartment, even though this old building has no washer/dryer hookups!
I'm an RVer traveling and don't have time for the Laundromat. This machine will make my life easier. Solid built machine that really cleans well.
Works great for rv. Cloths dry quickly with the spin cycle. Have to adjust hose to get to drain sometimes.

We bought this little washer for our machine shop, to wash the shop rags and aprons, and I also bring my dirty gardening gloves from home and wash those in this machine, too....basically things that are so dirty I don't care to put them through my regular washer at home.  For those jobs, it's perfect, gets the items clean enough for their purpose with a single 6 min wash cycle, followed by a 2 min spin with the water spraying during the first min of the spin cycle, then back to the washing tub for a 6 min rinse, then the final spin/spray for 3 mins before hanging to dry.  The spin bin is amazing, very powerful, and, as others have said, the clothes come out dry enough to need only about an hour hanging on the line to dry the rest of the way.  The washer's agitator is also good, although the constant "agitate for a very short time, stop, reverse directions, agitate again for a short time, stop, reverse directions and repeat" seems like alot of stopping and starting that I doubt does anything more as far as cleaning the clothes than simply allowing the agitator to run steadily in one direction.  All that starting and stopping seems to me to be something that will wear out the motor much more quickly.  Time will tell.  I see no difference between the "Normal" wash cycle and the "Soft" wash cycle except that there may be a few seconds less time before it stops and reverses directions.....even MORE stopping and starting, so, after initially trying the Soft
Love the washer, the only thing it hard to find a adapter to fit the sink faucet. It would be awesome if it came with one. The washer does exactly what I ordered it for.

This little  washer was a good purchase. It's been about 2weeks  now and it has done good so far. Nothing beats doing laundry in the comfort of your own home. My only problem is the hose that comes with it is not very compatible with any of my Faucets around my house, this seems to be common complait. but still I can get my laundry done. Cleaning cycle is very strong, spinners is owesome the items come out almost dry . This washer has paid for it self already.delivery was fast and by the tracking information is was done within the GOOD USA.

When I ordered this I had no idea that it was going to stand waist high and be 2-1/2 to 3 feet long so when I got it it was quite large for the small area that I live in.  so I asked for permission to return it. which they gave but the product cost $120 and when I went to  return it the shipping back was $108 so needless to say I just kept the washer it works fine I have appreciated having it except it's much larger than I expected and it's in my way but as far as it washing good it does.
The best thing i buy on Amazon prime  perfec
It works great!
Works great I love it very easy to work, doesn't make noise and clean great the clothes

I live in a 1 bedroom apartment and no laundry facilities are available where I live and none for over 12 miles from my apartment. So I decided to buy one of these compact washer/spin dryers to see if it could wash my clothes for me and do some sort of spin drying afterwards. This item weighs around 31 pounds and easy to move around when empty. I do not use the water connection hose when filling this washer tub up and just use buckets of water and pour it into the washer tub directly. It holds around 8 pounds of clothes in the washer and the spin dryer thingie really just holds a few pounds at the most and very picky when spin drying. But the washer works quite well and seems to do a terrific job washing my clothes in 15 minutes. It's pretty easy to use and a quick note, the instruction manual I got is not for this particular unit, it's for another unit. So, I tossed out the instruction manual and figured how to use this compact washer/spin dryer on my own....but it's pretty simple to use. I drain the wash water directly into the bath tub and for the most part, it works well enough. The spin dryer thingie works well enough but only handles a few items at one time or it will literally move the unit around when it's out of balance. But it does wring out excess water and partially dries clothes somewhat, especially smaller items. I gave this item 4 stars mostly because of the rather dinky spin dry tub compared to the washer capacity on this unit and the wrong instruction manual
These reviews speak the truth! Great buy and money saver!
It cleans ok i wish the drain pump was more stronger.
It cleans ok i wish the drain pump was more stronger.

After buying 3 machines this one is the best ever I love it and recommended and the spinner is the best the clothes come out super dry.
Update: October 2018 all this time the machine was working great but now the pump died and won't drain water now time to buy a new one or fix it

Amazing washer. Easy to use and works very well. The spin dry cycle is really amazing as well. With just a minute clothes are close to being dry. I would highly recommend for those trying to save time from going to laundry mat and it's easy to keep in a small apartment.
Unable to hook up in my new apartment
Great except for the sub-par hoses that don't fit any faucet and are too short. Otherwise it is a great product.

This machine works well and gets clothing clean. The spin cycle was very strong for getting most of moisture out of clothes. I didn't get the hose to fit to water supply, so I used a large container to fill up wash bin. The draining tube is fairly short and has gravity operation, so putting the machine up off the floor proved to be the best way and I let it drain into the bath tub. It isn't very heavy. Other than a few issues with the filling hose and draining, this machine will clean your clothes.

I received this product in approximately 4 days and I'm so glad I ordered it. The portability of the unit makes it easy to use in my Studio apartment. It did clean my clothes very well. It also has a very powerful spin/dry cycle. My clothes were dry once out of a 1 minute cycle. The instructions were easy to read and follow and I am very pleased.

While the pump isn't quite what I expected, the product itself is pretty good. It cleans clothes better than my previous full size washer. Would recommend for those in a small apartment w/o washer/dryer looking for a cheaper alternative.
Good experience

Wash tub holds more than I thought it would.  Gets clothes clean.  I'm glad I spent a few dollars more and got this one with a pump that pumps the water out.  I have a handheld shower so I just put it in to fill.  I'm in agreement with other reviewers on no way the hose attaches to any faucet.  The spin dryer gets most of the water out and as long as you use fabric softner they're not too wrinkled.  Beats going to the laundromat!
got my machine and I just love it! works great drains fast ! spins clothes almost dry!

I really like this little machine it washes well and spins well.  The only problem is the intake water hose, it does not fit any normal faucet.  However, I will try to purchase another water hose that will fit (from a hardware store).  For the price of this machine you can't go wrong, it's more than I expected.

This machine is great!  I get happy every time I wash because I'm saving $$$  It's a little time consuming to do laundry as 1) The hose that comes with it must fit the sink in a doll house...it's way too small for any faucet I have so I fill the machine using a water picture.  2) I have to put it in the bathtub to drain properly.  3) The washer load amount VS the spinner load amount is quite different so it might take you four spin cycles to a wash load.  4) It's awesome because it really does spin the clothes to almost completely dry but be careful how you place the items in the basket or it will be off-centered and will not spin well.  4) Use a very small amount of detergent.  I like that I can let really soiled items soak for awhile and wash as long as needed to get items clean.  I would recommend this to anyone who doesn't have washer/dry hookups and has a small space.  This machine is perfect.
Great little machine no problems and saves you time and money
Hoses don't reach and I couldn't find any that fit. The filter broke the first time I used it. Probably won't recommend.

Got tired of doing laundry by hand between trips to the laundry so deIcided to purchase a small machine for the house.  Opted for the model with the water pump to empty.  I really love this system.  I wish the drain pump worked better (if there is only a small amount of water left, it doesn't push the water out on its own.  I have to use like a gravity hose to get it started, but then it pumps properly).  Other than the pump issue, this machine does an excellent cleaning job.  I usually wash clothes in cold water and I love that I can let it agitate for only a few minutes and then leave it to soak for a bit before I give a last little agitation and drain.  The laundry is cleaner than it gets at the coin laundry and it's cheaper too!.  Except for large items like blankets and towels, we are now doing all of our laundry at home!

This was one of my most regrettable purchases. Basically i had to hand wash my clothes with this machine. It took multiple spin cycles to even ring the clothes out. Still wet. Drain did not always work.

I absolutely LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this washer/spinner! I put mine up on a cooler and put a bucket beside it for drainage. I do think I will get a longer hose for draining and a different hose that fits my water faucet. Right now I use my water sprayer to fill the washing basin.  I am careful how I drop it the wet clothes to the spinner because it needs to be balanced. I bought the washing balls and quite frankly I put about a teaspoon of soap in it. It works extremely well. Its so very nice to not have to go to the washateria anymore. This is one of the best purchases I have made in ages. I'm very, very pleased.

Cute little washer, got it in a pinch while my big washer is replaced. I had also recently purchased the Della mini washer for my son's apt, but that was no longer available so after a lot of deliberation bought this one. The spin drum is lined with a pseudo stainless wrap which is nice, spins excellent, clothes come out mildly wet to damp dry depending on the item. The drain hose is shorter on this than on the Della so I had to finagle around my bathroom to get it to my shower basin. The washer compartment is about the same, same type of agitation. Just don't overfill these washers, it will definitely  burn out the motor. A common wash is 3 big towels and a few washcloths. Or, 2 pairs of men's jeans, 2 men's boxer shorts, 3 prs socks I T shirt and thats MAX. Clothes came out clean and fresh. I used Nellie's detergent and it was a match made in heaven.
Awful, quit working a little over a month later

This machine is terrible. The hose that comes with it has no way to connect to any sink. And is a cheap plastic tube. The washer has a distinct burning smell even with no clothing inside when turned on, it is near impossible to rinse all soap residue from the clothing even after multiple water changes and spinning inbetween. Water turned almost completely black with each wash even if I was only washing white items. Makes a lot of noise even if it is balanced and done correctly. I was so disappointed with this purchase.

I live in a very small apartment and this machine fits perfectly in my bathroom. So right off the bat I loved it. It gets my clothes clean and the spin bucket does an excellent job of getting my clothes fairly dry. It came with a single hose to use for hooking up to a faucet but I don't use it since it sits right next to my tub I just opted to use my shower head to fill the wash tub.

The only reason I don't give it a 5 star rating is that it doesn't drain completely.

When you do a load you have to split it in 2 in order to spin dry it, so what happens is when you are loading the second load in to the dryer bucket the bottom of the wash bucket has soaking wet clothes from sitting in water. It not a huge deal and is really more of a mild annoyance.

Overall I couldn't be happier with this purchase and would definitely recommend it to anyone in the market for one of these. Given what it is, it is surprisingly quiet (ish). When you first start the spin cycle it doesn't tend to get loud and wobbly but within a few seconds it evens out and spins smooth as peanut butter (not the chunky kind though).

I live in a studio apartment and the laundromat is a bit of a walk away, so I thought this would be a life saver.
Pros:
•It's nice and small, it doesn't take up too much room.
•The washer portion is big
•The lint trap is easy to clean
•And it doesn't take much water or time!

Cons:
•The dryer portion is tiny (so you can't put much in there)
•I have to siphon the drain hose to get it to drain (so I have to suck on the hose to drain dirty water)
•The spin portion of the washer barely moved the clothes (so if you have pets this will not remove the hair from clothes)
•The water hose doesn't actually hook up the the sink (I just use a 5 gallon bucket to fill it and drain into)
•you can't just throw stuff from the washer to the dryer. You have to wash with soap, spin dry after adding a bit of water, put back into the washer (with clean water), and then you spin dry. The spin dry will not get all the water out so be prepared to hang dry.
So it's nice if you want to wash some towels, small blankets, or maybe some shirts...but I kind of wish I would've saved my money for something else.

This little washer has been a life safer for a friend who lives on a fixed income and has developed continence issues. The complex coin laundry costs $3.25 a load to wash and dry. At almost 10 loads per week, this unit paid for itself in one month. Sure, the capacity is small, but that's actually a plus since he washes his clothes as he wets it instead of having to wait a to fill the high capacity commercial washer in his building. He purchased a hanging clothes rack that he'll sit outside to dry. The unit fits perfectly inside his walk-in shower and does not connect it a facet. Instead, he uses the shower head to fill the unit as needed. It is noisy and it sometimes doesn't drain when it in that setting. But he's discovered that unplugging the unit for a few seconds and turning the wash to drain mode, easily fixes the problem. The spin bin is small and will require the clothes be spun in 2 batches. It does not dry the clothes. It only wrings them out to about 90% dry, depending on the fabric.

Just remember to keep the doors open otherwise the washer will start to have a mildew smell. He uses this washer 99% of the time instead of using the commercial coin washer in his building. I recommended using a scent booster such as Gain so his clothes always have a nice scent to them.

What I like:
This machine does a good job of getting my laundry clean and can also handle queen sheets and bath towels (I wash the fitted and flat sheets seperately. For towels, 2 bath towels + 2 hand towels at a time). I wash laundry for 1 on average 4 times a week so this purchase paid for itself right away. I don't need to go to a laundry, I can wash whenever I want and I avoid using the nasty, expensive laundromat machines. I can be at home, also I save on gas by not driving.
I have been using this machine heavily for several months now and the motors are still as strong as when they were new.

The not so good:
My machine leaks from the top edge a little bit when running the spin dryer. I just put a towel underneath to absorb drips. It's not very much and I usually cause an equal amount just moving the wet stuff into the spinner.
The agitator will come off if I don't tighten the screw that holds it on every few loads. This happened the first week I used it and it's been a minor routine maintenance issue from the start.
The drain pump is flakey. When rinsing clothes in the spinner the pump is inconsistent in draining accumulated water, sometimes it kicks in, other times it doesn't and the spinner gets too full of water to spin properly (if I turn off the spinner for a second then turn it back on the pump will activate and drain the water). This means I need to babysit when rinsing this way so the rinse tub doesn't overfill. It seems that
The pump stopped working after one month of use. Very disappointed. I had high hopes for this product , I would like a refund please!!!!
I'm so pleased with this product. It's much more than I expected. It's exactly what I needed. It washes very well and the spinner pretty much removes most of the water from your clothes.
Love my washing machine, best purchase I ever made.

It's a great machine!  I watched all the video reviews and knew what I was getting.  I do a wash cycle and a rinse cycle on the left side, and my clothes come out just like I want them.. clean and smelling fresh.  The spin dryer is sufficient, and I hang dry my clothes without a problem.

I had it on the floor in the bathroom but it wouldn't drain.  I made a 3' x4' board for on top of the tub and put it on.  Now it drains great.  I also added a couple shower curtain rods for on top of the tub to dry the clothes.  It isn't automatic, it takes a little effort, but it is great for a single person.  It washes good. I'm happy.

I love this.  It is big enough to put quite a bit of clothes in and wash good.  It just spins so if you put pants or long sleeve shirts in there they might get tangled up.  I put one pair of pants and socks, undies, and t-shirts and that works good.  The spinner gets them almost completely dry.  The spinner is the ultimate in compact washers, a must have.

This appears to be identical to http://amzn.com/B01ICBLBL0, except for minor cosmetic differences. This review is for that machine, which I purchased from Amazon.

To minimize the water-wasting and labor-intensiveness problems, get the large size - typically listed as 11 to 13 lbs capacity. (Don't worry, it is still small and light.) To minimize the knot-tying problem, always use small washable laundry bags!

This is obviously meant to be used in a bathtub or shower.
